has notation projection profile

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasNotationProjectionProfile
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasNotationProjectionProfile
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/notation
  • Box roles: ConfigBox role, RBox role (What is this?)

Links a notation system to its GMEOW projection profile. Non-functional: a future notation system may have co-existing profiles for different consumer contexts.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:NotationSystem -> gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasNotationProjectionProfile from gmeow:NotationSystem to gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:NotationSystem, gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use from a notation system to reach its projection profile(s) — the notation-rooted inverse of gmeow:notationSystemOf, natural when traversing from the surface form to its loss ledger.

Avoid when

  • Avoid asserting it directly when gmeow:notationSystemOf is the natural direction (assert that and read this as its inverse) and avoid assuming a single profile — different consumer contexts may carry co-existing profiles.

How to use

  • Prefer asserting gmeow:notationSystemOf on the profile and reading gmeow:hasNotationProjectionProfile as its inverse; reach for it explicitly only in notation-rooted traversals.

Examples

  • ex:westernStaff gmeow:hasNotationProjectionProfile ex:staffProfile.
